title: Popeye the Sailor Meets Sindbad the Sailor
description: Popeye the Sailor Meets Sindbad the Sailor is a animated cartoon short subject in the Popeye Color Feature series, produced in Technicolor and released to theatres on November 27, 1936 by Paramount Pictures. It was produced by Max Fleischer for Fleischer Studios, Inc. and directed by Dave Fleischer, with musical supervision by Sammy Timberg. The voice of Popeye is performed by Jack Mercer, with Mae Questel, as Olive Oyl, with Lou Fleischer as J. Wellington Wimpy and Gus Wickie as Sindbad the Sailor.
ai_summary: A classic Fleischer Studios cartoon with high visual stimulation and medium conflict.
